---
title: "BigData_Wetland_migratoryBirds: future environment from raw SSP values"
author: "Youn Jae Kang"
date: "2026-10-15"
output: html_document
---

Projects daily air temperature, wind speed, SPI6, water temperature, BOD, DTN and
chlorophyll-a for the winters (Oct-Apr) of 2031-2050 under SSP2-4.5, at the Hangang
stations Paju and Cheorwon.

1. **Water-quality models.** On the actual sampling dates (Oct-Apr), one linear regression
   per variable on that day's observed station climate:
   - water temperature ~ station + K-day mean air temperature
   - log(1 + BOD / DTN / Chl-a) ~ station + K-day mean air temperature + K-day mean wind
     + SPI6 + seasonal cycle (sin/cos of day of year)
2. **Running-mean window.** Candidate windows are compared by leave-one-winter-out error.
   Performance was nearly identical across windows, so K is fixed at 7 days (one K shared
   by all variables).
3. **Validation.** Leave-one-winter-out with the chosen K. RMSE, MAE and R² per variable,
   in original units.
4. **Future climate.** The SSP2-4.5 values of the grid cell nearest each station. Air temperature
   and wind are daily; SPI6 is monthly in the SSP file, so each day takes its month's value.
5. **Future water quality.** The models predict each future day from that day's SSP
   climate.
6. **Output.** Native resolution (daily file + monthly SPI6 file), plus the existing daily
   and 30-min interpolation files used by script 06.
7. **Historical vs. future.** Historical = HMM covariates when cranes were in the Hangang
   (`In_Hangang == 1`), as daily means. Future = 2031-2050 values on the same calendar days.

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(ncdf4)
library(effectsize)
```

```{r settings}
stations      <- c("Paju", "Cheorwon")
station_xy    <- tibble(Station = stations, lon = c(126.79618, 127.3113), lat = c(37.76469, 38.1485))
WINTER_MONTHS <- c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4)
K_CANDIDATES  <- c(1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14, 21, 30)   # running-mean windows compared in section 3
K_OVERRIDE    <- 7                               # window used; NULL = use the window selected in section 3
FUT_YEARS     <- 2031:2070

# Time conventions (same as 04 and 06):
TZ_LOCAL   <- "Asia/Seoul"
ANCHOR_KST <- "12:00:00" # a daily value is anchored at 12:00 KST of its day (= 03:00 UTC), as in 04.
SPI6_DAY   <- "first"    # day of its month each monthly SPI6 value is placed on: "first" or "last"

paths <- list(
  water_chem    = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/water_Chem_paju_cheorwon_2016_2024.csv",

  clim_cheorwon = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/hourly_climate/cheorwon_climate_2014_2024.csv",
  spi6_obs      = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/daily_drought/cheorwon_paju_spi6_2016_2024.csv",
  hmm_data      = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/global_hmm_data.csv",
  nc_grid       = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/Wetland_2006_2023/Korea_2000_2019_yearly_climate/평균기온_MKPRISMv21_skorea_TA_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  temp_folder   = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/SSP/realistic/temperature_SSP245_2031_2070_asc",
  temp_prefix   = "AR6_SSP245_5ENSMN_skorea_TA_gridraw_daily_",   # + <year>.txt
  wind_folder   = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/SSP/realistic/windspeed_SSP245_2031_2070_asc",
  wind_prefix   = "AR6_SSP245_5ENSMN_skorea_WS_gridraw_daily_",   # + <year>.txt
  spi6_file     = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/SSP/realistic/SPI6_SSP245_monthly_2021_2100_asc/AR6_SSP245_5ENSMN_skorea_SPI6_gridraw_monthly_2021_2100.txt",
  spi6_start    = "2021-01-01",                                    # first month in the SPI6 file
  out_dir       = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability"
)
paths$supp_dir <- file.path(paths$out_dir, "supp05_predict_env")
dir.create(paths$supp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Winter label: Oct-Dec 2020 and Jan-Apr 2021 both belong to winter 2020
season_year <- function(d) ifelse(month(d) >= 5, year(d), year(d) - 1)

# Mean of the last k days (including the day itself)
run_mean <- function(x, k) {
  m <- rollapplyr(x, k, mean, na.rm = TRUE, partial = TRUE)
  m[!is.finite(m)] <- NA
  m
}

# Adds k-day running means of air temperature and wind, per station
add_running <- function(d, k) {
  d %>%
    group_by(Station) %>%
    arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Temp_k = run_mean(Temp, k), Wind_k = run_mean(Wind, k)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

var_levels <- c("Temp", "Wind", "SPI6", "wTemp", "BOD", "DTN", "Chlor")

# Anchor time (UTC) of a daily value: 12:00 KST of its day
anchor_utc <- function(d) with_tz(as.POSIXct(paste(d, ANCHOR_KST), tz = TZ_LOCAL), "UTC")

# Day of its month that a monthly SPI6 value is placed on
spi6_day <- function(month_start) {
  if (SPI6_DAY == "first") return(month_start)
  d <- (month_start %m+% months(1)) - days(1)
  if_else(format(d, "%m-%d") == "02-29", d - days(1), d)   # SSP daily files have no 29 Feb
}
```

## 1. Observed daily data

```{r observed}
# Hourly station climate -> daily means
clim <- bind_rows(read.csv(paths$clim_paju), read.csv(paths$clim_cheorwon)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(as.POSIXct(Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "Asia/Seoul"),
                        tz = "Asia/Seoul")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
  group_by(Station, Date) %>%
  summarise(Temp = mean(Temperature.C., na.rm = TRUE),
            Wind = mean(Wind_Speed.m.s., na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

spi <- read.csv(paths$spi6_obs) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date_Time)) %>%
  group_by(Station, Date) %>%
  summarise(SPI6 = mean(SPI6, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Complete daily series per station (running means are added once K is known)
daily_obs <- full_join(clim, spi, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Temp, Wind, SPI6), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA))) %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "day")) %>%
  arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Water-quality samples (Oct-Apr)
wq_samples <- read.csv(paths$water_chem) %>%
  transmute(Station, Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y.%m.%d"),
            wTemp = Water_Temperature, BOD, DTN, Chlor = Chlorophyll) %>%
  group_by(Station, Date) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(month(Date) %in% WINTER_MONTHS) %>%
  mutate(Winter = season_year(Date), doy = yday(Date))

# Samples with the climate of the sampling day, for a k-day running mean
wq_for_k <- function(k) {
  wq_samples %>%
    left_join(add_running(daily_obs, k), by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
    mutate(Station = factor(Station, levels = stations))
}

# Supplementary: water-quality samples available for the models (Oct-Apr)
sample_summary <- wq_samples %>%
  pivot_longer(c(wTemp, BOD, DTN, Chlor), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Station) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), n_winters = n_distinct(Winter),
            first = min(Date), last = max(Date),
            mean = mean(Value), sd = sd(Value), min = min(Value), max = max(Value), .groups = "drop")
print(sample_summary)
```

## 2. Water-quality models

For water temp:
wTemp = b₀ + b_station + b₁·Temp_k

For BOD/DTN/CHl-a:
log(1 + BOD) = b₀ + b_station + b₁·Temp_k + b₂·Wind_k + b₃·SPI6 + b₄·sin(2π·doy/365) + b₅·cos(2π·doy/365)

1. Takes that day’s SSP air temperature and wind at the grid cell nearest the station.
2. Computes the 7-day means ending that day (Temp_k, Wind_k).
3. Looks up that month’s SPI6 and the day of year.
4. Plugs these into the equation to get log(1 + BOD).
5. Back-transforms with exp(·) × Duan’s smearing factor − 1, and floors the result at 0.

```{r models}
models <- list(
  wTemp = wTemp ~ Station + Temp_k,
  BOD   = log1p(BOD)   ~ Station + Temp_k + Wind_k + SPI6 + sin(2*pi*doy/365) + cos(2*pi*doy/365),
  DTN   = log1p(DTN)   ~ Station + Temp_k + Wind_k + SPI6 + sin(2*pi*doy/365) + cos(2*pi*doy/365),
  Chlor = log1p(Chlor) ~ Station + Temp_k + Wind_k + SPI6 + sin(2*pi*doy/365) + cos(2*pi*doy/365)
)
log_vars <- c("BOD", "DTN", "Chlor")

# Model variables present in a data set
model_vars <- function(v, data) intersect(all.vars(models[[v]]), names(data))

# Samples with the response and every predictor present
model_data <- function(v, data = wq) {
  data %>% filter(if_all(all_of(model_vars(v, data)), ~ !is.na(.x)))
}

fit_model <- function(v, data) {
  m <- lm(models[[v]], data = data)
  # Smearing factor: back-transforming a log-scale mean otherwise underestimates the mean
  m$smear <- if (v %in% log_vars) mean(exp(residuals(m))) else 1
  m
}

# Predictions in original units, never below 0
predict_model <- function(m, v, newdata) {
  p <- predict(m, newdata = newdata)
  if (v %in% log_vars) p <- exp(p) * m$smear - 1
  pmax(p, 0)
}

# Leave-one-winter-out predictions for variable v on data d
loyo <- function(v, d = model_data(v)) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(d$Winter)), function(w) {
    m    <- fit_model(v, filter(d, Winter != w))
    test <- filter(d, Winter == w)
    tibble(Station = as.character(test$Station), Date = test$Date, Winter = w,
           obs = test[[v]], pred = predict_model(m, v, test))
  }))
}

scores <- function(obs, pred) tibble(
  n    = length(obs),
  RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2)),
  MAE  = mean(abs(obs - pred)),
  R2   = 1 - sum((obs - pred)^2) / sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)
)
```

## 3. Choosing the running-mean window K
Each candidate K is scored by leave-one-winter-out prediction error. 

```{r window selection}
wq_by_k <- lapply(setNames(K_CANDIDATES, K_CANDIDATES), wq_for_k)

# Same samples for every window
common_data <- function(v, k) {
  keep <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(wq_by_k, function(d) complete.cases(d[, model_vars(v, d)])))
  wq_by_k[[as.character(k)]][keep, ]
}

k_overall <- k_cv %>%
  group_by(K) %>%
  summarise(mean_nRMSE = mean(nRMSE), mean_R2 = mean(R2), .groups = "drop")
K_best <- k_overall$K[which.min(k_overall$mean_nRMSE)]
K      <- if (is.null(K_OVERRIDE)) K_best else K_OVERRIDE
print(k_overall)

# Data used from here on
wq <- wq_for_k(K)
```
Out-of-sample performance was largely insensitive to the window: across 1-30 days, mean
RMSE varied only between 0.68 and 0.69 (mean R² 0.49-0.51). 
K is therefore fixed at 7 days (`K_OVERRIDE`), which scored within 0.01 of
the best window and relies less on day-to-day variability that the SSP ensemble mean smooths.

## 4. Leave-one-winter-out validation

There are 10 winters (2015–2024). For each winter, the script:
1. Removes all samples from that winter.
2. Fits each model on the remaining 9 winters.
3. Predicts the removed winter’s samples and stores them next to the observed values.

```{r validation}
cv_pred <- bind_rows(lapply(names(models), function(v) loyo(v) %>% mutate(Variable = v, .before = 1)))

# Supplementary: out-of-sample scores, both stations pooled and per station
cv_scores <- bind_rows(
  cv_pred %>% group_by(Variable) %>% summarise(scores(obs, pred)) %>% mutate(Station = "Both"),
  cv_pred %>% group_by(Variable, Station) %>% summarise(scores(obs, pred), .groups = "drop")
) %>%
  relocate(Variable, Station) %>%
  arrange(match(Variable, var_levels), Station != "Both", Station)
print(cv_scores)
write_csv(cv_scores, file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S2_LOYO_scores.csv"))
write_csv(cv_pred,   file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S2_LOYO_predictions.csv"))
```

RMSE and MAE are in the units of each variable (°C, mg/L, mg/L, ug/L). 
R² is out-of-sample (1 - SSE / SST on the held-out samples), so it can be negative.

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=2.6}
# Supplementary figure: observed vs. held-out predictions, 1:1 line
p_cv <- ggplot(cv_pred, aes(obs, pred, color = Station)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(Variable, levels = var_levels), scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Predicted (held-out winter)", color = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_cv)
ggsave(file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S2_LOYO_obs_vs_pred.pdf"), p_cv, width = 8, height = 2.6)
```

```{r final models}
# Final models, fitted on all winters (no LOWO)
final <- lapply(setNames(names(models), names(models)), function(v) fit_model(v, model_data(v)))

# Supplementary: coefficients and in-sample fit of the final models
coef_table <- bind_rows(lapply(names(final), function(v) {
  cf <- summary(final[[v]])$coefficients
  tibble(Variable = v, Scale = ifelse(v %in% log_vars, "log(1 + y)", "original"),
         Term = rownames(cf), Estimate = cf[, 1], SE = cf[, 2], t = cf[, 3], p = cf[, 4])
}))
fit_table <- tibble(Variable    = names(final),
                    n           = sapply(final, nobs),
                    R2_in       = sapply(final, function(m) summary(m)$r.squared),
                    Residual_SE = sapply(final, sigma))
print(coef_table, n = Inf)
print(fit_table)
write_csv(coef_table, file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S3_model_coefficients.csv"))
write_csv(fit_table,  file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S3_model_fit.csv"))
```

## 5. Future climate (raw SSP values) and water quality
1. Locate each station on the SSP grid.
2. Read the raw SSP climate for those two cells.
3. Build the daily predictor table
4. Predict water quality. The final models were fitted on all observed winters. They are applied to each future day:
- Water temperature is linear in station and Temp_k.
- BOD, DTN and Chl-a are predicted on the log(1+y) scale from station, Temp_k, Wind_k, SPI6 and the sin/cos seasonal terms. They are back-transformed as exp(·) × Duan’s smearing factor − 1 and floored at 0.

```{r grid cells}
# Grid cell nearest each station, on the MK-PRISM grid (cells numbered lon-fastest,
# as the columns of the SSP .txt files). Expected: Paju 357707, Cheorwon 387047.
nc <- nc_open(paths$nc_grid)
grid <- expand.grid(lon = as.numeric(ncvar_get(nc, "longitude")),
                    lat = as.numeric(ncvar_get(nc, "latitude")))
nc_close(nc)
cells <- sapply(seq_along(stations), function(i)
  which.min((grid$lon - station_xy$lon[i])^2 + (grid$lat - station_xy$lat[i])^2))

# Supplementary: grid cell used for each station and its distance from the station
grid_check <- station_xy %>%
  mutate(cell = cells, grid_lon = grid$lon[cells], grid_lat = grid$lat[cells],
         dist_km = 111.32 * sqrt((grid_lat - lat)^2 + ((grid_lon - lon) * cos(lat * pi / 180))^2))
print(grid_check)

# The SSP files must be on the same grid: number of columns = number of grid cells
check_cols <- function(file) {
  n_col <- ncol(data.table::fread(file, nrows = 1, header = FALSE))
  if (n_col != nrow(grid)) warning(basename(file), ": ", n_col, " columns but ",
                                   nrow(grid), " grid cells; the station columns may be wrong")
}
check_cols(file.path(paths$temp_folder, paste0(paths$temp_prefix, min(FUT_YEARS), ".txt")))
check_cols(paths$spi6_file)
```

```{r future}
# The two station columns of one SSP file, in station order
read_cells <- function(file) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(file, header = FALSE, select = cells))
  setNames(d[, paste0("V", cells)], stations)
}

# Daily SSP files (one per year) -> Station, Date, Value. 365-day calendar: no 29 Feb.
read_ssp_daily <- function(folder, prefix) {
  bind_rows(lapply(FUT_YEARS, function(yr) {
    d <- read_cells(file.path(folder, paste0(prefix, yr, ".txt")))
    dates <- seq(as.Date(paste0(yr, "-01-01")), as.Date(paste0(yr, "-12-31")), by = "day")
    if (nrow(d) == 365) dates <- dates[format(dates, "%m-%d") != "02-29"]
    d$Date <- dates
    pivot_longer(d, all_of(stations), names_to = "Station", values_to = "Value")
  }))
}

ssp_temp <- read_ssp_daily(paths$temp_folder, paths$temp_prefix) %>% rename(Temp = Value)
ssp_wind <- read_ssp_daily(paths$wind_folder, paths$wind_prefix) %>% rename(Wind = Value)
ssp_spi  <- read_cells(paths$spi6_file) %>%
  mutate(Month_Start = seq(as.Date(paths$spi6_start), by = "month", length.out = n())) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(stations), names_to = "Station", values_to = "SPI6")

# Daily future climate; running means over the full-year series, then winter days only
future <- inner_join(ssp_temp, ssp_wind, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
  mutate(Month_Start = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  left_join(ssp_spi, by = c("Station", "Month_Start")) %>%
  add_running(K) %>%
  filter(month(Date) %in% WINTER_MONTHS) %>%
  mutate(Winter = season_year(Date), doy = yday(Date))

# Water quality from the future climate of each day
nd <- mutate(future, Station = factor(Station, levels = stations))
future <- future %>%
  mutate(Pred_Water_Temp  = predict_model(final$wTemp, "wTemp", nd),
         Pred_BOD         = predict_model(final$BOD,   "BOD",   nd),
         Pred_DTN         = predict_model(final$DTN,   "DTN",   nd),
         Pred_Chlorophyll = predict_model(final$Chlor, "Chlor", nd))

# Supplementary: share of future days outside the observed range, for every variable.
# - Model predictors (Temp_k, Wind_k, SPI6): range on the sampling days the models were
#   fitted on; outside it, predictions extrapolate the linear relationships.
# - Daily air temperature and wind: range of the observed daily station climate, Oct-Apr.
# - Predicted water quality: range of the observed samples; outside it, the predicted value
#   is beyond anything measured at the stations.
obs_winter <- filter(daily_obs, month(Date) %in% WINTER_MONTHS)
range_ref <- tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Future_col,         ~Reference,
  "Temp",    "Temp",              "Observed daily station climate (Oct-Apr)",
  "Wind",    "Wind",              "Observed daily station climate (Oct-Apr)",
  "Temp_k",  "Temp_k",            "Sampling days used to fit the models",
  "Wind_k",  "Wind_k",            "Sampling days used to fit the models",
  "SPI6",    "SPI6",              "Sampling days used to fit the models",
  "wTemp",   "Pred_Water_Temp",   "Observed water-quality samples",
  "BOD",     "Pred_BOD",          "Observed water-quality samples",
  "DTN",     "Pred_DTN",          "Observed water-quality samples",
  "Chlor",   "Pred_Chlorophyll",  "Observed water-quality samples"
)
ref_values <- function(v) if (v %in% c("Temp", "Wind")) obs_winter[[v]] else wq[[v]]

extrapolation <- pmap_dfr(range_ref, function(Variable, Future_col, Reference) {
  r <- range(ref_values(Variable), na.rm = TRUE)
  future %>%
    group_by(Station) %>%
    summarise(Variable = Variable, Reference = Reference, obs_min = r[1], obs_max = r[2],
              future_min = min(.data[[Future_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              future_max = max(.data[[Future_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              pct_below = 100 * mean(.data[[Future_col]] < r[1], na.rm = TRUE),
              pct_above = 100 * mean(.data[[Future_col]] > r[2], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}) %>% relocate(Variable, Reference)
print(extrapolation, n = Inf)
write_csv(extrapolation, file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S5_extrapolation.csv"))
```

```{r output}
# 30-min series for 06 

# Cubic spline through the anchors, evaluated at t_out; values outside the anchor range are
# held at the nearest anchor
spline_at <- function(t_anchor, y, t_out) {
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  x  <- as.numeric(t_anchor[ok])
  f  <- splinefun(x, y[ok], method = "fmm")
  f(pmin(pmax(as.numeric(t_out), min(x)), max(x)))
}

# Spline each variable within the groups given by `by`
interp_spline <- function(grid, anchors, vars, by) {
  grid %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
    group_modify(function(g, key) {
      a <- semi_join(anchors, key, by = by) %>% arrange(t)
      for (v in vars) g[[v]] <- spline_at(a$t, a[[v]], g$Date_Time)
      g
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# 30-min grid (UTC) covering every KST day of each winter
grid_30min <- future %>%
  group_by(Station, Winter) %>%
  summarise(from = min(Date), to = max(Date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Date_Time = map2(from, to, ~ with_tz(
    seq(as.POSIXct(paste(.x, "00:00:00"), tz = TZ_LOCAL),
        as.POSIXct(paste(.y, "23:30:00"), tz = TZ_LOCAL), by = "30 min"), "UTC"))) %>%
  select(Station, Winter, Date_Time) %>%
  unnest(Date_Time)

# Anchors: daily climate (all days of the year), monthly SPI6 (all months), daily water quality (winter days)
anchors_clim <- inner_join(ssp_temp, ssp_wind, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
  transmute(Station, t = anchor_utc(Date), Temperature.C. = Temp, Wind_Speed.m.s. = Wind)
anchors_spi6 <- ssp_spi %>%
  transmute(Station, t = anchor_utc(spi6_day(Month_Start)), SPI6_Smooth = SPI6)
wq_out <- c("Pred_Water_Temp", "Pred_BOD", "Pred_DTN", "Pred_Chlorophyll")
anchors_wq <- future %>%
  transmute(Station, Winter, t = anchor_utc(Date), across(all_of(wq_out)))

future_30min <- grid_30min %>%
  interp_spline(anchors_clim, c("Temperature.C.", "Wind_Speed.m.s."), by = "Station") %>%
  interp_spline(anchors_spi6, "SPI6_Smooth", by = "Station") %>%
  interp_spline(anchors_wq, wq_out, by = c("Station", "Winter")) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(wq_out), ~ pmax(.x, 0))) %>%      # spline overshoot below 0
  arrange(Station, Date_Time) %>%
  select(Station, Date_Time, all_of(out_vars))
write_csv(future_30min, file.path(paths$out_dir, "future_env_2031_2070_30min_rawSSP.csv"))
```

## 7. Historical vs. future, cranes in the Hangang

Historical: HMM covariates at the times cranes were in the Hangang (`In_Hangang == 1`),
averaged per station and day (the future is daily, so both are compared as daily values).
Future: 2031-2050 values on the same calendar days.

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hist_env <- read.csv(paths$hmm_data) %>%
  filter(In_Hangang == 1, Station %in% stations) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(ymd_hms(roundT, tz = "UTC", truncated = 3), tz = "Asia/Seoul")) %>%
  filter(month(Date) %in% WINTER_MONTHS) %>%
  group_by(Station, Date) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(var_levels), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(var_levels), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA)))

hist_days <- hist_env %>% count(Station, MD = format(Date, "%m-%d"), name = "n_hist")
fut_matched <- future %>%
  mutate(MD = format(Date, "%m-%d")) %>%
  inner_join(hist_days, by = c("Station", "MD")) %>%
  uncount(n_hist) %>%
  transmute(Station, Temp, Wind, SPI6, wTemp = Pred_Water_Temp, BOD = Pred_BOD,
            DTN = Pred_DTN, Chlor = Pred_Chlorophyll)

to_long <- function(d) d %>% select(Station, all_of(var_levels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Station, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")
cmp_long <- bind_rows(Historical = to_long(hist_env), Future = to_long(fut_matched), .id = "Period") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = var_levels),
         Period   = factor(Period, levels = c("Historical", "Future")))
mu_df <- cmp_long %>% group_by(Variable, Period) %>% summarise(grp_mean = mean(Value), .groups = "drop")

distribution_plot <- ggplot(cmp_long, aes(x = Value, fill = Period)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = mu_df, aes(xintercept = grp_mean, color = Period, linetype = Period),
             linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Historical" = "grey", "Future" = "dodgerblue3"),
                    labels = c("Historical" = "Historical (observed, cranes in Hangang)",
                               "Future" = "Future (2031-2050, SSP2-4.5)"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Historical" = "grey20", "Future" = "dodgerblue4"), name = NULL) +
  labs(y = "Probability Density") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.48, 0.08), panel.spacing.y = unit(20, "pt"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
print(distribution_plot)
ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/env_shift_SSP245.pdf", plot = distribution_plot, height = 4, width = 8)

# Supplementary: historical vs. future summary per station
shift_summary <- cmp_long %>%
  group_by(Variable, Station, Period) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(Value), sd = sd(Value), median = median(Value),
            q05 = quantile(Value, 0.05), q95 = quantile(Value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
print(shift_summary, n = Inf)
write_csv(shift_summary, file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S6_historical_vs_future_summary.csv"))

effect_size <- cmp_long %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ as.data.frame(rank_biserial(Value ~ Period, data = .x))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Effect = cut(abs(r_rank_biserial), c(-Inf, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, Inf),
                      labels = c("Negligible", "Small", "Moderate", "Large"), right = FALSE))
print(effect_size)
write_csv(effect_size, file.path(paths$supp_dir, "S6_effect_sizes.csv"))
```
Effect sizes by $|r_{rb}|$: 
< 0.10 negligible, 
0.10-0.30 small, 
0.30-0.50 moderate,
≥ 0.50 large. 
Positive $r_{rb}$: historical values tend to be higher than future values.

## SSP1.2-6 (green scenario) and SSP5.8-5 (worst scenario) models

```{r scenario setup}
ssp_root <- "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/SSP"

other_scenarios <- tibble(
  name  = c("green", "worst"),
  code  = c("126", "585"),
  label = c("SSP1-2.6", "SSP5-8.5"),
  fill  = c("forestgreen", "firebrick3"),   # colours for the section 9 figures
  line  = c("darkgreen", "firebrick4")
)

# Folders, file prefixes and SPI6 file pattern of one scenario (same layout as SSP2-4.5)
scen_paths <- function(name, code) list(
  temp_folder  = file.path(ssp_root, name, paste0("temperature_SSP", code, "_2031_2070_asc")),
  temp_prefix  = paste0("AR6_SSP", code, "_5ENSMN_skorea_TA_gridraw_daily_"),
  wind_folder  = file.path(ssp_root, name, paste0("windspeed_SSP", code, "_2031_2070_asc")),
  wind_prefix  = paste0("AR6_SSP", code, "_5ENSMN_skorea_WS_gridraw_daily_"),
  spi6_folder  = file.path(ssp_root, name, paste0("SPI6_SSP", code, "_monthly_2021_2100_asc")),
  spi6_pattern = paste0("^AR6_SSP", code, "_5ENSMN_skorea_SPI6_gridraw_monthly_2021_2100.*\\.txt$")
)

# First file in `folder` whose name matches `pattern`; if none, extract the archives in
# `folder` to a temporary folder and look there
find_ssp_file <- function(folder, pattern) {
  look <- function(dir) {
    if (!dir.exists(dir)) return(character(0))
    f <- list.files(dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    sort(f[grepl(pattern, basename(f))])
  }
  hit <- look(folder)
  if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])
  ex_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "ssp_untar", basename(dirname(folder)), basename(folder))
  hit <- look(ex_dir)
  if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])
  archives <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.(tar\\.gz|tgz|tar)$", full.names = TRUE)
  for (a in archives) untar(a, exdir = ex_dir)
  hit <- look(ex_dir)
  if (!length(hit)) stop("No file matching '", pattern, "' in ", folder)
  hit[1]
}

# Daily SSP files (one per year) -> Station, Date, Value. As read_ssp_daily(), but finds
# the files with find_ssp_file()
read_ssp_daily_scen <- function(folder, prefix) {
  bind_rows(lapply(FUT_YEARS, function(yr) {
    d <- read_cells(find_ssp_file(folder, paste0("^", prefix, yr, "(_asc)?\\.txt$")))
    dates <- seq(as.Date(paste0(yr, "-01-01")), as.Date(paste0(yr, "-12-31")), by = "day")
    if (nrow(d) == 365) dates <- dates[format(dates, "%m-%d") != "02-29"]
    stopifnot(nrow(d) == length(dates))
    d$Date <- dates
    pivot_longer(d, all_of(stations), names_to = "Station", values_to = "Value")
  }))
}

# Section 5 for one scenario: raw SSP climate, running means, predicted water quality
build_future <- function(sp) {
  temp_first <- find_ssp_file(sp$temp_folder, paste0("^", sp$temp_prefix, min(FUT_YEARS), "(_asc)?\\.txt$"))
  spi6_file  <- find_ssp_file(sp$spi6_folder, sp$spi6_pattern)
  check_cols(temp_first)
  check_cols(spi6_file)

  ssp_temp <- read_ssp_daily_scen(sp$temp_folder, sp$temp_prefix) %>% rename(Temp = Value)
  ssp_wind <- read_ssp_daily_scen(sp$wind_folder, sp$wind_prefix) %>% rename(Wind = Value)
  ssp_spi  <- read_cells(spi6_file) %>%
    mutate(Month_Start = seq(as.Date(paths$spi6_start), by = "month", length.out = n())) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(stations), names_to = "Station", values_to = "SPI6")

  fut <- inner_join(ssp_temp, ssp_wind, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
    mutate(Month_Start = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
    left_join(ssp_spi, by = c("Station", "Month_Start")) %>%
    add_running(K) %>%
    filter(month(Date) %in% WINTER_MONTHS) %>%
    mutate(Winter = season_year(Date), doy = yday(Date))

  nd <- mutate(fut, Station = factor(Station, levels = stations))
  fut <- fut %>%
    mutate(Pred_Water_Temp  = predict_model(final$wTemp, "wTemp", nd),
           Pred_BOD         = predict_model(final$BOD,   "BOD",   nd),
           Pred_DTN         = predict_model(final$DTN,   "DTN",   nd),
           Pred_Chlorophyll = predict_model(final$Chlor, "Chlor", nd))

  list(ssp_temp = ssp_temp, ssp_wind = ssp_wind, ssp_spi = ssp_spi, future = fut)
}

# Share of future days outside the observed range (as S5_extrapolation above)
extrapolation_table <- function(fut) {
  pmap_dfr(range_ref, function(Variable, Future_col, Reference) {
    r <- range(ref_values(Variable), na.rm = TRUE)
    fut %>%
      group_by(Station) %>%
      summarise(Variable = Variable, Reference = Reference, obs_min = r[1], obs_max = r[2],
                future_min = min(.data[[Future_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                future_max = max(.data[[Future_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                pct_below = 100 * mean(.data[[Future_col]] < r[1], na.rm = TRUE),
                pct_above = 100 * mean(.data[[Future_col]] > r[2], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }) %>% relocate(Variable, Reference)
}

# Section 6 for one scenario: native daily, native monthly SPI6, interpolated daily and 30-min
write_scenario_outputs <- function(sc, code) {
  fut <- sc$future
  tag <- paste0("rawSSP", code)

  native_daily <- fut %>%
    mutate(SPI6 = if_else(Date == spi6_day(Month_Start), SPI6, NA_real_)) %>%
    transmute(Station, Date, Winter,
              Temperature.C. = Temp, Wind_Speed.m.s. = Wind,
              Temp_runmean = Temp_k, Wind_runmean = Wind_k, runmean_days = K,
              SPI6,
              Pred_Water_Temp, Pred_BOD, Pred_DTN, Pred_Chlorophyll) %>%
    arrange(Station, Date)
  write_csv(native_daily, file.path(paths$out_dir, paste0("future_env_2031_2070_native_daily_", tag, ".csv")),
            na = "")

  native_spi6 <- sc$ssp_spi %>%
    semi_join(distinct(fut, Station, Month_Start), by = c("Station", "Month_Start")) %>%
    transmute(Station, Month = format(Month_Start, "%Y-%m"), Winter = season_year(Month_Start), SPI6) %>%
    arrange(Station, Month)
  write_csv(native_spi6, file.path(paths$out_dir, paste0("future_SPI6_2031_2070_native_monthly_", tag, ".csv")))

  daily <- fut %>%
    transmute(Station, Date, Winter,
              Temperature.C. = Temp, Wind_Speed.m.s. = Wind, SPI6_Smooth = SPI6,
              Pred_Water_Temp, Pred_BOD, Pred_DTN, Pred_Chlorophyll)
  write_csv(daily, file.path(paths$out_dir, paste0("future_env_2031_2070_daily_", tag, ".csv")))

  grid30 <- fut %>%
    group_by(Station, Winter) %>%
    summarise(from = min(Date), to = max(Date), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Date_Time = map2(from, to, ~ with_tz(
      seq(as.POSIXct(paste(.x, "00:00:00"), tz = TZ_LOCAL),
          as.POSIXct(paste(.y, "23:30:00"), tz = TZ_LOCAL), by = "30 min"), "UTC"))) %>%
    select(Station, Winter, Date_Time) %>%
    unnest(Date_Time)

  a_clim <- inner_join(sc$ssp_temp, sc$ssp_wind, by = c("Station", "Date")) %>%
    transmute(Station, t = anchor_utc(Date), Temperature.C. = Temp, Wind_Speed.m.s. = Wind)
  a_spi6 <- sc$ssp_spi %>%
    transmute(Station, t = anchor_utc(spi6_day(Month_Start)), SPI6_Smooth = SPI6)
  a_wq <- fut %>%
    transmute(Station, Winter, t = anchor_utc(Date), across(all_of(wq_out)))

  out30 <- grid30 %>%
    interp_spline(a_clim, c("Temperature.C.", "Wind_Speed.m.s."), by = "Station") %>%
    interp_spline(a_spi6, "SPI6_Smooth", by = "Station") %>%
    interp_spline(a_wq, wq_out, by = c("Station", "Winter")) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(wq_out), ~ pmax(.x, 0))) %>%
    arrange(Station, Date_Time) %>%
    select(Station, Date_Time, all_of(out_vars))
  #write_csv(out30, file.path(paths$out_dir, paste0("future_env_2031_2070_30min_", tag, ".csv")))
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## 9. Historical vs. future, cranes in the Hangang: SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5

Same comparison as section 7 (historical HMM covariates while cranes were in the Hangang vs.
2031-2050 values on the same calendar days), for the other two scenarios.

```{r scenario compare helpers}
compare_scenario <- function(fut, code, label, fill_col, line_col) {
  fut_m <- fut %>%
    mutate(MD = format(Date, "%m-%d")) %>%
    inner_join(hist_days, by = c("Station", "MD")) %>%
    uncount(n_hist) %>%
    transmute(Station, Temp, Wind, SPI6, wTemp = Pred_Water_Temp, BOD = Pred_BOD,
              DTN = Pred_DTN, Chlor = Pred_Chlorophyll)

  cl <- bind_rows(Historical = to_long(hist_env), Future = to_long(fut_m), .id = "Period") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = var_levels),
           Period   = factor(Period, levels = c("Historical", "Future")))
  mu <- cl %>% group_by(Variable, Period) %>% summarise(grp_mean = mean(Value), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot(cl, aes(x = Value, fill = Period)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(data = mu, aes(xintercept = grp_mean, color = Period, linetype = Period),
               linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Historical" = "grey", "Future" = fill_col),
                      labels = c("Historical" = "Historical (observed, cranes in Hangang)",
                                 "Future" = paste0("Future (2031-2050, ", label, ")")),
                      name = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Historical" = "grey20", "Future" = line_col), name = NULL) +
    labs(y = "Probability Density") +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.48, 0.08), panel.spacing.y = unit(20, "pt"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
  #ggsave(paste0("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/env_shift_SSP", code, ".pdf"), plot = p, height = 4, width = 8)

  # Supplementary: summary and effect sizes per scenario
  summ <- cl %>%
    group_by(Variable, Station, Period) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(Value), sd = sd(Value), median = median(Value),
              q05 = quantile(Value, 0.05), q95 = quantile(Value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
  #write_csv(summ, file.path(paths$supp_dir, paste0("S6_historical_vs_future_summary_SSP", code, ".csv")))

  es <- cl %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    group_modify(~ as.data.frame(rank_biserial(Value ~ Period, data = .x))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Effect = cut(abs(r_rank_biserial), c(-Inf, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, Inf),
                        labels = c("Negligible", "Small", "Moderate", "Large"), right = FALSE))
  list(plot = p, summary = summ, effect_size = es)
}

cmp_scen <- lapply(setNames(seq_len(nrow(other_scenarios)), other_scenarios$code), function(i) {
  s <- other_scenarios[i, ]
  compare_scenario(scen_out[[s$code]]$future, s$code, s$label, s$fill, s$line)
})
```
